# Issue #2: capacity and working-memory regression tests

[English](README.md) | [日本語](../../../../ja/test_case/offline/issue2/README.md) | [Français](../../../../fr/test_case/offline/issue2/README.md) | [中文](../../../../../test_case/offline/issue2/README.md)

<!-- Generated by npm run docs:localize; edit docs/i18n/translations.json. -->

This directory’s `*.test.ts` runs with `npm test`; TypeScript helpers are checked by `npm run check`. Tests use temporary Stores, synthetic streams, and controllable model capacities.

Coverage includes budget parameters, system/tool declarations in normalized requests, output and safety reserves, input overflow, full checkpoint persistence, current-turn tool-result recovery, working memory and context trimming, 8-turn maintenance, throttling, frozen sources, settings rebuilds, and historical input projection. Maintenance retries after #19 follow current clock and count rules.

Tests assert actual adapter requests and persisted records. [Online scenarios](../../online/README.md) validate semantic memory quality. Old browser/PTY helpers retired in PR3b; this directory continues validating capacity, request, and checkpoint domain assertions. Historical scripts are recoverable before their deletion commit.

See the [fix record](../../../../fix/archive/fix_20261005_issue2_上下文容量与记忆分离计划.md) for the original plan and acceptance matrix, and the [memory and budget guide](../../../memory-and-prompts.md) for current parameters.

The [historical baseline](../../../../../test_case/offline/issue2/baseline-20261005.md) preserves the full pre-implementation 13-item INV/GOAL matrix, original result explanations, and then-uncovered cases.
